scripts.dev: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && bun run --filter @codesymphony/shared-types build && bun run --filter @codesymphony/chat-timeline-core build && bun --watch --env-file=.env src/index.ts
scripts.start: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && bun run --filter @codesymphony/shared-types build && bun run --filter @codesymphony/chat-timeline-core build && bun --env-file=.env src/index.ts
scripts.build: prisma generate && bun run --filter @codesymphony/shared-types build && bun run --filter @codesymphony/chat-timeline-core build && if [ ! -d dist ]; then rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; fi; tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/services && cp src/services/ptyHost.mjs dist/services/ptyHost.mjs
scripts.test: DATABASE_URL="file:./test.db" prisma migrate deploy && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
